questions.q: If y = log(2x + 3), then dy/dx is —
If y = e^(−3 log x), then dy/dx is —
questions.work: e^(−3 log x) = e^(log x⁻³) = x⁻³ ⇒ dy/dx = −3x⁻⁴.

questions.q: The derivative of sin x with respect to log x is —
questions.work: (d sin x/dx)/(d log x/dx) = cos x/(1/x) = x cos x.

sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (a) If y = e^(sin⁻¹x), then dy/dx = ______. (b) d/dx(xˣ) = ______.
questions.answer:
(a) e^(sin⁻¹x) × 1/√(1 − x²).
(b) log y = x log x ⇒ y'/y = log x + 1 ⇒ xˣ(1 + log x).

questions.q: True or False: (a) If y = 500e^(7x) + 600e^(−7x), then d²y/dx² = 49y. (b) d/dx(log x²) = 1/x².
questions.answer:
(a) True: y' = 3500e^(7x) − 4200e^(−7x), y'' = 24500e^(7x) + 29400e^(−7x) = 49y.
(b) False — log x² = 2 log x, derivative 2/x.

questions.q: If y = eˣ log(1 + x²), find dy/dx.
questions.answer: Product rule: eˣ log(1 + x²) + eˣ × 2x/(1 + x²) = eˣ[log(1 + x²) + 2x/(1 + x²)].

questions.q: Find dy/dx for y = x^(x cos x).
questions.answer:
log y = x cos x log x.
(1/y)y' = cos x log x − x sin x log x + cos x.
y' = x^(x cos x)[cos x(1 + log x) − x sin x log x].

questions.q: If x = a(cos θ + log tan(θ/2)) and y = a sin θ, find d²y/dx².
questions.answer:
dx/dθ = a(−sin θ + 1/sin θ) = a cos²θ/sin θ. dy/dθ = a cos θ.
dy/dx = a cos θ × sin θ/(a cos²θ) = tan θ.
d²y/dx² = sec²θ × dθ/dx = sec²θ × sin θ/(a cos²θ) = sin θ/(a cos⁴θ).
